Messages.Author: Angus, the Unruled
Messages.Body:
Just needing a clarification in this:

Acting Minion A get blocked by Minion B. Minion A uses Anesthetic
Touch at superior, minion B uses his gun. Can Minion B use the Gun
with Dragon's Breath Rounds, and maybe play Rötschreck thereafter?

I think not, because Dragon's Breath Rounds is played "as damage is
being resolved", which would be after the combat ended because of
Anesthetic Touch's combat ends after first strike.

Right?

Messages.Author: Angus, the Unruled
Messages.Body:
2 needed Clarifications:

1st: Minion A is blocked by minion B. Minion a uses Anesthetic Touch
at superior, Minion B uses his gun. Can Minion B play Dragon's Breath
Rounds and Rötschreck thereafter?

I think not, because Combat is ended before Damage from Gun is being
resolved, thus the controller of Minion B has no time to play Dragon's
Breath rounds, and thus cannot use Rötschreck, as his Minion does no
agg. damage.

2nd: Minion A is using Combat ends. Same as before, there is no time
to play Dragon's Breath rounds.

Correct?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <690c2085.02101...@posting.google.com>, "Angus,

the Unruled" <athosg...@gmx.at> writes:
>Acting Minion A get blocked by Minion B. Minion A uses Anesthetic
>Touch at superior, minion B uses his gun. Can Minion B use the Gun
>with Dragon's Breath Rounds, and maybe play Rötschreck thereafter?

Yes.

>I think not, because Dragon's Breath Rounds is played "as damage is
>being resolved",

Current card text:

"Only usable before resolution of a gun's strike."

>which would be after the combat ended because of
>Anesthetic Touch's combat ends after first strike.

which isn't.

# Ammo (Dragon's Breath Rounds, Glaser Rounds, Manstopper Rounds) are
played "before resolution of a gun's strike", not "when damage from a
gun is being resolved". That is, it is played after the strike is
announced, but before the strike resolution phase. [RTR 19990105]

>Right?

Wrong.

Messages.Author: Luis Duarte
Messages.Body:
athosg...@gmx.at (Angus, the Unruled) wrote in message news:<690c2085.02101...@posting.google.com>...


The thing is that both combatants _play/choose_ their strikes at the same
time, although the AT strike is resolved first.
DBR must be played before Strike Resolution.
This means that, before the strike resolution of AT, Minion B can
play DBR and Rotschreck.

.- Luis Duarte
